name: easel-ai-media
description: AI images, video and voice through a provider layer that uses your own API keys, with cost estimates before spending

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Google Gemini key, stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable, or if you do not use Google Gemini.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional. Your own OpenAI key, stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable, or if you do not use OpenAI.

fal_api_key.title: fal.ai API key
fal_api_key.description: Optional. Your own fal.ai key, stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the FAL_KEY environment variable, or if you do not use fal.ai.

replicate_api_key.title: Replicate API key
replicate_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Replicate key, stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the REPLICATE_API_TOKEN environment variable, or if you do not use Replicate.

atlas_api_key.title: Atlas Cloud API key
atlas_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Atlas Cloud key, stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY environment variable, or if you do not use Atlas Cloud.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Optional. Your own ElevenLabs key, stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable, or if you do not use ElevenLabs.

max_spend_usd.title: Spending limit per generation (USD)
max_spend_usd.description: A generation whose estimate is above this needs an amount you approve. Every paid call is still shown and confirmed first.
